verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes the JMAP API, an open, documented standard with a session object that advertises capabilities. The pack, however, never mentions API version numbers, version pinning, or any deprecation or sunset policy. Capability discovery and the protocol being an open standard are adjacent to stability guarantees, not a documented versioning and deprecation policy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
